_comment: Hand-authored. Bank 6 object handlers: types $16, $17, $18, $19 ($8BEF-$8D6F). The generators subtract these.

regions.name: TYPE $16 (the enemy that hangs on the scrolling background and then flies off; corridor 16's spawn script uses it): first frame?
regions.description: TYPE $16 (the enemy that hangs on the scrolling background and then flies off; corridor 16's spawn script uses it): type bit 7 set (initialised) goes to `$8C1F`. Stats from the tables: hit points 16, attack 96, collision flags 0, drawing flags `$1B`, art block `$3A`, dies as type 8 (an explosion).

regions.name: TYPE $16 (the enemy that hangs on the scrolling background and then flies off; corridor 16's spawn script uses it): art wait
regions.description: `JSR $C0A8` (`$CF5F`): if the type's art block is not among the 16 loaded ones the object waits (768 frames, undrawn) and the rest of the handler is skipped; if it is, the block's base tile goes to `$06C8` and `$07E8`.

regions.name: TYPE $16 (the enemy that hangs on the scrolling background and then flies off; corridor 16's spawn script uses it): where it starts
regions.description: y `$0518` = 0: `JSR $C0F0` (`$F9E9`): a random x of 32-223 and y = 8, the top of the screen. (A spawner can give a position instead.)

regions.name: TYPE $16 (the enemy that hangs on the scrolling background and then flies off; corridor 16's spawn script uses it): tile base
TYPE $16 (the enemy that hangs on the scrolling background and then flies off; corridor 16's spawn script uses it): set-up
regions.description: `JSR $C0A2`, palette `$0560` := 1, metasprite `$0548` := `$1A`, then a random number AND `$7F` + `$20` into `$0788`: the y at which it will stop being part of the scenery (32-159). RUN: the type spawned alone in a corridor state with its art block marked loaded.

regions.name: TYPE $16 (the enemy that hangs on the scrolling background and then flies off; corridor 16's spawn script uses it): every frame: still scenery?
regions.description: `$0788` zero means the second phase (`$8C50`).

regions.name: TYPE $16 (the enemy that hangs on the scrolling background and then flies off; corridor 16's spawn script uses it): phase 1: carried by the scroll
regions.description: `JSR $C12C` (`$FCD5`) adds the scroll step to y, so the object stays where it is on the background and slides down the screen with it. While y is under `$0788` and the scroll is moving (`$B8 OR $B9`) it is only drawn (`$C090`), tested against fixed targets (`$C0CF`, mask `$20`) and resolved (`$C0D2`). RUN: y 10, 12, 14 ... (2 a frame), the scroll step.

regions.name: TYPE $16 (the enemy that hangs on the scrolling background and then flies off; corridor 16's spawn script uses it): phase 2: it breaks away
regions.description: y has reached `$0788` (or the scroll has stopped): `$0788` := 0, `$0698` := 6 (the speed class), `JSR $C0FC` (`$F85D`: aim at the player and set the velocity), palette := 2. RUN: after y 156 the velocity pointed at the player's side and the object flew off the screen and was removed.

regions.name: Wing animation, then move (types $16 and $17)
regions.description: `JSR $C0A5` (`$CD7A`) with step `$40` over 7 phases (a new phase every 4 frames); the phase picks the metasprite `$8C6A[phase]` (`$1A`, then `$19`), the flip bits `$14` = `$8C71[phase]` (`$40` = flipped) and a tile offset `$15` = `$8C78[phase]` (`$0C 08 04 00 00 04 08`); `JSR $A1D8` stores them (`$0548`, `$0560` low two bits, `$06C8` = `$07E8` + offset) and `JMP $9F4F`: move and draw (`$CBE8`), the hit test as an ordinary enemy (`$D294`, mask `$30`) and its consequences (`$D2BB`).

regions.name: Wing animation: metasprite by phase
Wing animation: flip bits by phase
Wing animation: tile offset by phase
TYPE $17 (a projectile with the same wings): all of it
regions.description: Not yet initialised: art wait, palette 0, A := `$0788,X` (the direction the spawner set), `JSR $C102` (direction to velocity with the speed class) and `JSR $C0A2`; then every frame the wing animation `$8C50`. Stats: hit points 16, attack 96, art block `$3A`, the same as type `$16`. Who creates it is not worked out (type `$18` summons type `$16`, not this one).

regions.name: TYPES $18 / $19 (EYEGORE, corridor bosses 9 and 10): first frame?
regions.description: TYPES $18 / $19 (EYEGORE, corridor bosses 9 and 10): bit 7 clear (type `$18` / `$19`): set-up; set: `$8CC8`. Stats: hit points 32 and 48, attack 96 and 112, collision flags `$5A`, drawing flags 3, art block `$42`, dies as type 7.

regions.name: TYPES $18 / $19 (EYEGORE, corridor bosses 9 and 10): palette and child type
TYPES $18 / $19 (EYEGORE, corridor bosses 9 and 10): art wait, hit points
regions.description: `JSR $C0A8`, then `JSR $C165` (`$D385`): the hit points are widened - the table value is split into a high part `$0740` (value / 16) and a low part `$0590` (the low nibble x 16), i.e. the boss really has 16 times the table's hit points. RUN: `$0740` = 2 and 3 for the two types.

regions.name: TYPES $18 / $19 (EYEGORE, corridor bosses 9 and 10): the entrance
regions.description: y speed `$05D8` := 1, metasprite `$82`, x := `$80`, `$0788` := `$60` (the y below which the entrance ends), `$0668` := 0 (the spring's target).

regions.name: TYPES $18 / $19 (EYEGORE, corridor bosses 9 and 10): every frame: the spring
regions.description: A := 2, `JSR $C09C` (`$CD12`): accelerate y toward the target `$0668`, 2/256 a frame.

regions.name: TYPES $18 / $19 (EYEGORE, corridor bosses 9 and 10): which phase
regions.description: `$0788` zero is the fight (`$8CF6`).

regions.name: TYPES $18 / $19 (EYEGORE, corridor bosses 9 and 10): phase 1: the slow entrance
regions.description: A speed of 0 or more only moves and draws (`JSR $C08D`, return). The target 0 pulls the speed down by 2/256 a frame, so it slows from 1 px a frame, stops after about 128 frames at y about 64 and starts back; when the speed is negative and y is under `$0788` the phase ends. RUN: y 1, 27, 46, 59, 61 ... 64 at frame 130.

regions.name: TYPES $18 / $19 (EYEGORE, corridor bosses 9 and 10): phase 2 begins
regions.description: `$0788` := 0, the spring target `$0668` := `$60` (y 96), palette := `$8CD2[type]` (read at `$8D6A / $8D6B`: 2 for `$18`, 0 for `$19`). RUN: y then swung between about 64 and 128 around 96.

regions.name: TYPES $18 / $19 (EYEGORE, corridor bosses 9 and 10): the fight: the timing
regions.description: `$41` AND `$1F` zero: fire a beam; otherwise AND `$0F` zero: summon.

regions.name: TYPES $18 / $19 (EYEGORE, corridor bosses 9 and 10): every 32 frames: a beam
regions.description: `JSR $C027` finds a slot (none: skip); a beam object (type `$22`, through `$C13E` = `$FE3D`) with tile base the boss's base + `$1C`, y speed 2 and the boss as its parent, styled by the record at `$FE22 + $15` (metasprite 0, `$0638` `$F0`, half-width 8); its y := the boss's + 16 and x := the boss's x + (`$41` AND `$7F`) / 2 - 24: the beam's x sweeps -24 to +40 with the frame counter. RUN: beams at frames where `$41` AND `$1F` = 0, x 120 for `$41` = 160 from a boss at 128.

regions.name: TYPES $18 / $19 (EYEGORE, corridor bosses 9 and 10): every 16 frames in between: a summon
regions.description: `JSR $AD9A` (a random 0 or 1), x offset `$8D6E[bit]` (-32 or +32), `JSR $C108` (`$FA5B`, a free slot, none: skip): the child's type := `$07B8,X` (`$16` or `$27`), y := boss y + 32, x := boss x + offset, `$07A0` := 3, `$0788` := the boss's y. RUN: type `$18` summoned `$16` objects, `$19` summoned `$27` (bullets), every 32 frames, at x 160.

regions.name: TYPES $18 / $19 (EYEGORE, corridor bosses 9 and 10): move and fight
regions.description: `JSR $C08D` (move and draw), `JSR $C0C6` (`$D294`, hit test, mask `$30`), `JMP $C0D8` (`$D39B`: the boss's resolution with the widened hit points).

regions.name: Eyegore: palettes, summoned type, x offset
regions.description: `01 03` initial palette for `$18` / `$19`; `02 00` the fight palette (read at `$8CD2 + type`); `16 27` the type summoned; `E0 20` the summon's x offset (-32, +32).
